text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval to prohibit eastbound left-turns, westbound right-turns and northbound through movements at all times at the intersection of Sixth Street and Morrison Street. The proposed turn prohibitions will reinforce the existing one-way southbound operation on Sixth Street, between Lake Shore Boulevard West and Morrison Street, and reduce potential vehicle conflicts.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited eastbound left-turns and westbound right-turns at all times on Sixth Street at Morrison Street. 2. Prohibited northbound through traffic entry at all times at the intersection of Morrison Street and Sixth Street.
